verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Deel publishes an llms.txt at deel.com (HTTP 200) describing Deel as a global HR and payroll platform, so an agent can be pointed at it. The visible content is company-wide, and it is unproven whether it covers Deel Immigration specifically. No other agent-oriented docs are evidenced, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Missing for 10: confirmation that llms.txt covers immigration services, immigration-specific agent-oriented docs or machine-readable API specs, hands-on corroboration that agents can use it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.deel.com/llms.txt # Deel
